submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2.0 mm gas gap is recommended as it is the only mixture that satisfies the mandatory GWP100 ≤ 150 environmental constraint. Among all tested gap configurations for Mixture-G3 (ranging from 1.0 to 3.0 mm), the 2.0 mm gap achieves the best time resolution of 1.99 ns. While Mixture-G1 (0.9 ns) and Mixture-G2 (1.3 ns) would provide superior time resolution, they fail to meet the hard environmental requirement and are therefore ineligible. The recommended configuration meets all project constraints while delivering the best achievable time resolution under the given environmental policy.
